prompt: On product pages, the left and right arrow keys skip images in the gallery: one press jumps two pictures, and after switching colours a few times it jumps even more. Fix the keyboard navigation.

truth.cause: The keydown listener is added with { capture: true } but removed without the capture flag, so removeEventListener never matches and every effect run (Strict Mode replay, each colour change) leaks another live listener that also advances the index.
truth.summary: Remove the listener with the same capture option it was added with, so cleanup actually detaches it.
